{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

GPUS="${1:?Usage: bash run_exp008.sh GPU_IDS (e.g. 1,4,5)}"

# === Paths ===
BASE_MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B"
INSTRUCT_MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"
D000_ADAPTER="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-0.5B_d000_s42/lora_adapter"
D100_ADAPTER="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-0.5B_d100_s42/lora_adapter"
SFT_DATA="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/sft_data/sft_dosage_100.jsonl"
LABELS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/sft_data"

OUTPUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/exp008"
SIGNALS_DIR="${OUTPUT_BASE}/signals"
RESULTS_DIR="${OUTPUT_BASE}/results"

BENCHMARKS=(mmlu gsm8k arc_challenge)
SIGNALS="embedding minkpp selfcritique"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
COMPUTE_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../exp002/compute_signals.py"
SURVIVAL_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/run_signal_survival.py"

# === Environment ===
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPUS"

# === Regime definitions ===
declare -A REGIME_MODEL REGIME_ADAPTER
REGIME_MODEL[base]="$BASE_MODEL";           REGIME_ADAPTER[base]=""
REGIME_MODEL[sft_clean]="$BASE_MODEL";      REGIME_ADAPTER[sft_clean]="$D000_ADAPTER"
REGIME_MODEL[sft_contam]="$BASE_MODEL";     REGIME_ADAPTER[sft_contam]="$D100_ADAPTER"
REGIME_MODEL[rl_aligned]="$INSTRUCT_MODEL"; REGIME_ADAPTER[rl_aligned]=""
REGIMES=(base sft_clean sft_contam rl_aligned)

echo "=== exp-008 Signal Survival ==="
echo "GPUs: $GPUS | Benchmarks: ${BENCHMARKS[*]} | Signals: $SIGNALS"
echo "Regimes: ${REGIMES[*]}"
echo ""

# === Step 0: Convert labels to {index: 0/1} format ===
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_BASE}/labels"
for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
    SRC="${LABELS_DIR}/contamination_labels_${bench}_d100.json"
    DST="${OUTPUT_BASE}/labels/labels_${bench}.json"
    if [ -f "$DST" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] labels ${bench} — already converted"
        continue
    fi
    python3 -c "
import json, sys
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f: raw = json.load(f)
labels = {str(i): v for i, v in enumerate(raw['labels'])}
with open(sys.argv[2], 'w') as f: json.dump(labels, f)
print(f'Converted {len(labels)} labels for {sys.argv[3]}')
" "$SRC" "$DST" "$bench"
done
echo ""

# === Step 1: Compute signals for each regime x benchmark ===
for regime in "${REGIMES[@]}"; do
    for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
        OUT="${SIGNALS_DIR}/${regime}/${bench}"
        mkdir -p "$OUT"

        if ls "${OUT}"/signals_merged_*.json 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "[SKIP] ${regime}/${bench} — merged signals exist"
            continue
        fi

        echo "[RUN] compute_signals: regime=${regime} benchmark=${bench}"
        CMD=(python "$COMPUTE_SCRIPT"
            --model-path "${REGIME_MODEL[$regime]}"
            --benchmark "$bench"
            --ref-model-path "$BASE_MODEL"
            --sft-data-path "$SFT_DATA"
            --output-dir "$OUT"
            --signals $SIGNALS
            --gpu 0)

        if [ -n "${REGIME_ADAPTER[$regime]}" ]; then
            CMD+=(--adapter-path "${REGIME_ADAPTER[$regime]}")
        fi

        "${CMD[@]}"
        echo "[DONE] ${regime}/${bench}"
        echo ""
    done
done

# === Step 2: Signal survival analysis per benchmark ===
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR"
for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
    echo "[RUN] signal_survival: benchmark=${bench}"

    REGIME_ARGS=()
    for regime in "${REGIMES[@]}"; do
        REGIME_ARGS+=("${regime}=${SIGNALS_DIR}/${regime}/${bench}")
    done

    python "$SURVIVAL_SCRIPT" \
        --regime-dirs "${REGIME_ARGS[@]}" \
        --labels-file "${OUTPUT_BASE}/labels/labels_${bench}.json" \
        --output-dir "${RESULTS_DIR}/${bench}"

    echo "[DONE] signal_survival: ${bench}"
    echo ""
done

echo "=== All done. Results: ${RESULTS_DIR} ==="
", "stderr": "", "return_code": 0}, "error": null, "metadata": {"elapsed_seconds": 1.86}}

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

GPUS="${1:?Usage: bash run_exp008.sh GPU_IDS (e.g. 1,4,5)}"

# === Paths ===
BASE_MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B"
INSTRUCT_MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"
D000_ADAPTER="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-0.5B_d000_s42/lora_adapter"
D005_ADAPTER="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-0.5B_d005_s42/lora_adapter"  # d005: mixed 0/1 labels, AUC computable
SFT_DATA="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/sft_data/sft_dosage_100.jsonl"
LABELS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/sft_data"

OUTPUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/exp008"
SIGNALS_DIR="${OUTPUT_BASE}/signals"
RESULTS_DIR="${OUTPUT_BASE}/results"

BENCHMARKS=(mmlu gsm8k arc_challenge)
SIGNALS="embedding minkpp selfcritique"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
COMPUTE_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../exp002/compute_signals.py"
SURVIVAL_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/run_signal_survival.py"

# === Environment ===
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPUS"

# === Regime definitions ===
declare -A REGIME_MODEL REGIME_ADAPTER
REGIME_MODEL[base]="$BASE_MODEL";           REGIME_ADAPTER[base]=""
REGIME_MODEL[sft_clean]="$BASE_MODEL";      REGIME_ADAPTER[sft_clean]="$D000_ADAPTER"
REGIME_MODEL[sft_contam]="$BASE_MODEL";     REGIME_ADAPTER[sft_contam]="$D005_ADAPTER"
REGIME_MODEL[rl_aligned]="$INSTRUCT_MODEL"; REGIME_ADAPTER[rl_aligned]=""
REGIMES=(base sft_clean sft_contam rl_aligned)

echo "=== exp-008 Signal Survival ==="
echo "GPUs: $GPUS | Benchmarks: ${BENCHMARKS[*]} | Signals: $SIGNALS"
echo "Regimes: ${REGIMES[*]}"
echo ""

# === Step 0: Convert labels to {index: 0/1} format ===
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_BASE}/labels"
for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
    SRC="${LABELS_DIR}/contamination_labels_${bench}_d005.json"
    DST="${OUTPUT_BASE}/labels/labels_${bench}.json"
    if [ -f "$DST" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] labels ${bench} — already converted"
        continue
    fi
    python3 -c "
import json, sys
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f: raw = json.load(f)
labels = {str(i): v for i, v in enumerate(raw['labels'])}
with open(sys.argv[2], 'w') as f: json.dump(labels, f)
print(f'Converted {len(labels)} labels for {sys.argv[3]}')
" "$SRC" "$DST" "$bench"
done
echo ""

# === Step 1: Compute signals for each regime x benchmark ===
for regime in "${REGIMES[@]}"; do
    for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
        OUT="${SIGNALS_DIR}/${regime}/${bench}"
        mkdir -p "$OUT"

        if ls "${OUT}"/signals_merged_*.json 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "[SKIP] ${regime}/${bench} — merged signals exist"
            continue
        fi

        echo "[RUN] compute_signals: regime=${regime} benchmark=${bench}"
        CMD=(python "$COMPUTE_SCRIPT"
            --model-path "${REGIME_MODEL[$regime]}"
            --benchmark "$bench"
            --ref-model-path "$BASE_MODEL"
            --sft-data-path "$SFT_DATA"
            --output-dir "$OUT"
            --signals $SIGNALS)

        if [ -n "${REGIME_ADAPTER[$regime]}" ]; then
            CMD+=(--adapter-path "${REGIME_ADAPTER[$regime]}")
        fi

        "${CMD[@]}"
        echo "[DONE] ${regime}/${bench}"
        echo ""
    done
done

# === Step 2: Signal survival analysis per benchmark ===
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR"
for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
    echo "[RUN] signal_survival: benchmark=${bench}"

    REGIME_ARGS=()
    for regime in "${REGIMES[@]}"; do
        REGIME_ARGS+=("${regime}=${SIGNALS_DIR}/${regime}/${bench}")
    done

    python "$SURVIVAL_SCRIPT" \
        --regime-dirs "${REGIME_ARGS[@]}" \
        --labels-file "${OUTPUT_BASE}/labels/labels_${bench}.json" \
        --output-dir "${RESULTS_DIR}/${bench}"

    echo "[DONE] signal_survival: ${bench}"
    echo ""
done

echo "=== All done. Results: ${RESULTS_DIR} ==="
", "stderr": "", "return_code": 0}, "error": null, "metadata": {"elapsed_seconds": 0.36}}
